summary: Cross-division seat reassignment: two-week access sunset and asset claim for transitioning engineer
description:
Issue summary:
The eng (previously on Team Search) is moving to Team Recommendations starting 2026-03-15. HR requested a two-week overlap where the employee retains a subset of Search accesses for handover while being granted full Recommendations access. This ticket coordinates seat/license reassignment for paid third-party tools, network desk/monitor ownership transfer, and timed deprovisioning of Search-only elevated roles.

Background:
- Employee: Marcus Li (shan-li@redwood.com)
- Effective transfer date: 2026-03-15
- Current assets: MacBook Pro (company-asset-3245), dual monitor stand, docking station, access to Search prod projects and admin role on internal Search debugging tools.
- Requested: 2-week access sunset window (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-29) during which Marcus can still access Search in read/limited-admin capacity to complete handover tasks. After 2026-03-29, Search elevated roles should be removed and any transferable license seats should be reclaimed or reassigned.

Impact:
- Business: Handover must be completed without blocking product launches scheduled 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-22. Incorrect immediate revocation would delay handover.
- Security: Need to ensure admin-level keys/service accounts used by Marcus are rotated/removed at sunset to avoid lingering privileges.

Requested actions:
1) Provision Recommendations team memberships and tool licenses by 2026-03-15 morning.
2) Create time-bound policy to reduce Search elevated roles to read-only on 2026-03-29 09:00 PT, then full removal 2026-03-30 09:00 PT if no escalations.
3) Reassign any transferable paid licenses (A/B testing dashboard, paid debug tools) to a pool or named engineer; reclaim others.
4) Clarify physical asset ownership: Marcus keeps MacBook; monitors and docking station to be claimed by receiving desk owner (Facilities ticket), confirm transfer or schedule pickup.
5) KMS/service-account rotation checklist to run once elevated roles are removed.

Attachments: HR transfer email thread, Marcus handover checklist (Google Drive link).
investigation_notes:
Checked asset inventory and confirmed MacBook serial and docking station serials; found no open loaner ticket. Queried license manager for A/B testing dashboard: 1 active seat assigned to marcus.li@redwood.com expiring 2026-12-31 (paid). Internal search-debug-admin role is bound to role id 'search-admin-v2' with two members including Marcus. No service-account keys are directly owned by the user, but Marcus has elevated access to the admin console.
Verified Recommendations team has 3 open seats; one seat will be used for Marcus. Confirmed HR requested two-week overlap in transfer email 2026-03-09.
Hypotheses: no infra blockers for time-bound access removal; main friction points are (a) license reallocation policy, (b) Facilities scheduling for monitor handoff, (c) scripted KMS rotation window coordination with SRE to avoid breaking scheduled jobs.
workarounds_tried: Temporarily set Search projects to require approval for critical changes and requested Marcus use a break-glass workflow for urgent fixes while in overlap window. Asked Marcus to transfer any local credentials to team vaults.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Nina Alvarez: Opening ticket per HR transfer request. Please coordinate license reassignment and schedule the timed deprovisioning. Marcus will begin Recommendations ramp on 2026-03-15.
2026-03-10 - Devon Park: Assigned. I'll provision team memberships and touch base with licensing. Requesting confirmation from Facilities about desk ownership transfer window.

2026-03-11 - Kate Morgan (HR): Confirmed two-week overlap approved. Marcus will complete handover doc by 2026-03-18. Facilities has tentative slot 2026-03-29 for monitor pickup but needs final approval.

2026-03-11 - Samir Desai (Licensing): We can move the A/B dashboard seat off Marcus and place into the shared pool on 2026-03-15. For the paid debug tool we need manager approval to reassign; pinging Marcus's manager.
2026-03-12 - Devon Park: Drafted time-bound IAM policy for Search role: read-only 2026-03-29 09:00 PT; full revoke 2026-03-30 09:00 PT. Posting below for SRE/InfoSec signoff.
resolution_notes:
Plan proposed and pending approvals:
- Recommendations membership provisioned on 2026-03-15 AM (in progress).
- A/B seat placed into shared pool 2026-03-15 after manager approval.
- Facilities to confirm monitor pickup 2026-03-29 by end of day; if not possible, schedule courier.
- IAM time-bound policy ready for InfoSec signoff; target enforcement 2026-03-29 09:00 PT.
- Post-revoke actions: run KMS rotation checklist and audit logs for one week.
Next steps: InfoSec and SRE to review IAM policy by 2026-03-13; Facilities to confirm handoff slot by 2026-03-16.
